body.text: How does Turkish Airlines' free Touristanbul schedule work for 6–24 hour layovers?

Updated on May 1, 2026, the official [Turkish Airlines Touristanbul schedule](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/flights/fly-different/touristanbul/) offers four fixed routes for international-to-international passengers on Turkish Airlines-operated tickets (starting with 235, same PNR) with a 6-to-24-hour layover at Istanbul Airport (IST). You must register at the Arrivals-level Touristanbul desk at least 30 minutes before tour departure.

Turkish Airlines estimates 45 minutes from landing to the Arrivals-level registration desk, including passport control, and requires at least 1 hour and 25 minutes between the tour's scheduled return to IST and your onward flight. The four 2026 slots are:

items: 08:00–11:30 Sightseeing Tour: Panoramic coach drive past Taksim, Golden Horn, and Dolmabahçe with a Galata Bridge photo stop; no museum entry.

08:30–15:00 Half-Day Tour: Includes breakfast and a rotating daily itinerary (for example, Sultanahmet and Topkapı Palace on Sundays, Dolmabahçe and Ortaköy on Tuesdays, or Eyüp, Balat, and Fener on Wednesdays).
16:00–21:30 Evening Tour: Covers Sultanahmet exteriors, the Grand Bazaar (closed Sundays), and dinner.
18:30–23:00 Bosphorus Tour: Seasonal route operating April 1 to October 31, pairing dinner with a Bosphorus cruise.

body.text: What happens if your inbound flight lands 30 minutes late?

If your inbound flight arrives 30 minutes late and pushes you past the 30-minute pre-departure desk cutoff, Touristanbul will not hold the bus—you forfeit that slot and can only join a later scheduled tour if your remaining layover still meets the 1-hour-25-minute pre-flight return buffer.

This inflexibility is Touristanbul's biggest operational weakness. Because IST is massive, taxiing to a remote gate and clearing passport control can easily eat 45 to 60 minutes on its own. With a private layover tour, your driver and licensed guide track your live flight number and simply shift pickup by 30 minutes, adjusting the city loop so you still reach Sultanahmet or Karaköy and return to IST with comfortable security margin.
How much more do you see with a private car and licensed guide?

A private vehicle and licensed Turkish guide typically deliver twice the actual on-the-ground sightseeing of Touristanbul on a 7-to-12-hour layover. Rather than waiting for 35 coach passengers to board, stop at fixed group restaurants, or view Hagia Sophia only from the outside, you choose exact interior stops and depart immediately upon exiting customs.

body.text: Traveling during quieter [winter months in Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/turkey-in-winter-premium-travel-guide) also works in a private tour's favor: museum queues shrink and you can swap outdoor rain-exposed stops for indoor highlights like the Basilica Cistern, Turkish and Islamic Arts Museum, or a warm historic hammam.
Where do you store cabin bags during a layover?

If you join Touristanbul, you cannot bring rolling suitcases onto the tour coach; instead, leave carry-ons at the staffed [iGA Istanbul Airport Left Luggage offices](https://www.istairport.com/en/services/discover/airport-facilities/left-luggage-offices-and-storage-lockers?locale=en) on the Arrivals floor (opposite Exit 13 and beside the domestic exit) or self-service lockers near Departures Gates 1 and 6. With a private car, your bags ride securely in the trunk.

Per iGA's published 2026 24-hour tariff, storing a small duty-free bag costs TRY 210, a medium cabin-sized bag costs TRY 270, a large hold suitcase costs TRY 550, and XL/XXL items cost TRY 690–860. Note that you must pass through passport control to access the Arrivals-floor left luggage offices.

items: Calculate true usable city time: Subtract 90 minutes for landing/immigration and 150 minutes before your next international flight; a 7-hour layover leaves roughly 3 hours in central Istanbul.
Verify Turkish entry visa rules first: Both Touristanbul and private tours require clearing Turkish immigration.

Check the Stopover conflict rule: Per the [Touristanbul FAQ](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/flights/fly-different/touristanbul/faq/), you cannot combine Touristanbul and the free Stopover Hotel on the same layover.
Check day-of-week closures: Topkapı Palace closes Tuesdays, Dolmabahçe Palace closes Mondays, and the Grand Bazaar closes Sundays.
Factor in peak Bosphorus traffic: Between 16:30 and 19:30 on weekdays, IST-to-Old City drives can stretch from 45 minutes to over 75 minutes.

faq.q: Can I book Touristanbul if I am flying an airline other than Turkish Airlines?
faq.a: No. Touristanbul is exclusively for passengers connecting international-to-international on Turkish Airlines-operated flights under a single reservation with a ticket number starting with 235.

faq.q: Does Touristanbul work from Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW)?
faq.a: No. Touristanbul operates exclusively out of Istanbul Airport (IST) on the European side. Layovers at Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) are not eligible.

faq.q: Is a 6-hour layover at IST enough for a private tour?
faq.a: Six hours is tight for leaving IST once you deduct immigration, 90–120 minutes of round-trip highway driving, and pre-flight security. Seven to eight hours is the realistic minimum for a relaxed private city loop.

faq.q: Are museum entrance tickets included on Touristanbul?
faq.a: When a scheduled Touristanbul route includes a paid museum or palace interior—such as Topkapı Palace on Sundays—admission is covered by Turkish Airlines. However, many stops are marked as outside visits only.

faq.q: How much does Istanbul Airport baggage storage cost in 2026?
faq.a: Under iGA's 2026 24-hour rates, small bags cost TRY 210, medium cabin bags cost TRY 270, and large checked suitcases cost TRY 550 at the Arrivals-level left luggage offices and Departures lockers.

faq.q: Can I pre-book Touristanbul online before flying?
faq.a: Yes. Eligible passengers can view and reserve compatible tour slots online on the official Touristanbul page using their PNR or 235-ticket number and surname, though you still must check in at the Arrivals-level desk 30 minutes before departure.
